description: This file contains unit tests for the TenantClientImpl class in the org.eclipse.hono.client.impl package, verifying its behavior in tenant information retrieval, caching, and message construction.

classes.name: TenantClientImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for TenantClientImpl testing tenant data retrieval, caching, error handling, and message content.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, mocking dependencies such as Vertx, ProtonSender, Trace spans, and cache.

methods.name: testGetTenantInvokesServiceIfNoCacheConfigured
methods.description: Verifies that tenant data is fetched from the service when no cache is configured.

methods.name: testGetTenantAddsInfoToCacheOnCacheMiss
methods.description: Checks that tenant info is added to the cache on cache miss during retrieval.

methods.name: testGetTenantReturnsValueFromCache
methods.description: Confirms tenant info is returned directly from cache if it exists.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsWithSendError
methods.description: Ensures failure occurs when the message cannot be sent due to a full send queue.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsWithRejectedRequest
methods.description: Checks proper error handling when the tenant request is rejected by the server.

methods.name: testGetTenantByCaUsesRFC2253SubjectDn
methods.description: Validates that the certificate subject DN is correctly formatted and included in the request payload.

methods.name: testGetTenantIncludesRequiredInformationInRequest
methods.description: Ensures that the tenant ID and message identifiers are correctly included in the request message.
